CREATE TABLE "socioeconomic_facilities" (
"id" TEXT,
  "name" TEXT,
  "category" TEXT,
  "sub_type" TEXT,
  "status" TEXT,
  "district" TEXT,
  "source_dataset" TEXT,
  "longitude" REAL,
  "latitude" REAL
, "x_coordinate_dd" REAL, "y_coordinate_dd" REAL, "coordinate_basis" TEXT)

CREATE TABLE master_road_sections (
    section_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    road_code TEXT,
    road_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    road_class TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'M', 'A', 'B', 'C', 'U', 'D', 'E', 'CAR'
    network_scope TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'National Road Network', 'DUCAR Network'
    governing_body TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'MoWT DNR', 'MoWT DUCAR'
    surface_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'Bituminous', 'Gravel', 'Earth', 'Concrete', 'Paving Blocks'
    condition_rating TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'Good', 'Fair', 'Poor', 'Very Poor'
    length_km REAL NOT NULL,
    design_speed_kmh REAL,
    carriageway_width_m REAL,
    lanes_count INTEGER,
    district_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    subcounty_name TEXT,
    aadt_count INTEGER,
    pcu_count INTEGER
)

CREATE TABLE pms_pavement_condition (
    section_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    iri_m_km REAL,
    rutting_mm REAL,
    cracking_pct REAL,
    potholes_count INTEGER,
    priority_score REAL,
    recommended_intervention TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY(section_id) REFERENCES master_road_sections(section_id)
)

CREATE TABLE traffic_survey_counts (
    survey_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    section_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    survey_year INTEGER,
    cars_count INTEGER,
    buses_count INTEGER,
    light_trucks INTEGER,
    heavy_trucks INTEGER,
    motorcycles_count INTEGER,
    total_pcu INTEGER,
    FOREIGN KEY(section_id) REFERENCES master_road_sections(section_id)
)

CREATE TABLE "ducar_link_admin_relations" ("link_id" TEXT,"source_code" TEXT,"road_name" TEXT,"district" TEXT,"admin_district" TEXT,"county" TEXT,"subcounty" TEXT,"parish" TEXT,"village" TEXT,"village_id" TEXT,"covered_length_km" REAL,"raw_covered_length_km" REAL,"coverage_scale" REAL,"surface" TEXT,"pavement_class" TEXT,"condition" TEXT,"source_length_km" REAL,"geometry_length_km" REAL,"length_quality" TEXT,"registry_speed_kmh" REAL,"registry_aadt" REAL,"registry_pcu" REAL,"traffic_source" TEXT,"traffic_measured" INTEGER,"traffic_length_km" REAL,"planning_priority_score" REAL,"priority_band" TEXT,"priority_basis" TEXT,"recommended_intervention" TEXT,"planning_unit_cost_ugx_km" INTEGER,"planning_cost_ugx" REAL,"cost_basis" TEXT,"record_status" TEXT,"relation_basis" TEXT, "x_coordinate_dd" REAL, "y_coordinate_dd" REAL, "coordinate_basis" TEXT)

CREATE TABLE "ducar_link_register" ("link_id" TEXT,"link_id_prefix" TEXT,"link_id_sequence" INTEGER,"link_id_namespace_sequence" INTEGER,"link_id_district" TEXT,"link_id_standard" TEXT,"link_id_assignment_basis" TEXT,"source_code" TEXT,"road_name" TEXT,"district" TEXT,"source_district" TEXT,"admin_district" TEXT,"county" TEXT,"subcounty" TEXT,"parish" TEXT,"surface" TEXT,"pavement_class" TEXT,"condition" TEXT,"source_length_km" REAL,"geometry_length_km" REAL,"length_variance_pct" REAL,"length_quality" TEXT,"registry_speed_kmh" REAL,"registry_aadt" REAL,"registry_pcu" REAL,"traffic_source" TEXT,"condition_risk" REAL,"surface_risk" INTEGER,"planning_priority_score" REAL,"priority_band" TEXT,"priority_basis" TEXT,"recommended_intervention" TEXT,"planning_unit_cost_ugx_km" INTEGER,"planning_cost_ugx" REAL,"cost_basis" TEXT,"record_status" TEXT,"admin_coverage" TEXT, "x_coordinate_dd" REAL, "y_coordinate_dd" REAL, "coordinate_basis" TEXT)

CREATE TABLE "socioeconomic_link_analysis" (
"link_id" TEXT,
  "road_name" TEXT,
  "district" TEXT,
  "county" TEXT,
  "subcounty" TEXT,
  "parish" TEXT,
  "geometry_length_km" REAL,
  "surface" TEXT,
  "pavement_class" TEXT,
  "condition" TEXT,
  "registry_aadt" REAL,
  "planning_priority_score" REAL,
  "recommended_intervention" TEXT,
  "socioeconomic_exposure_score" REAL,
  "primary_socioeconomic_factor" TEXT,
  "nearest_school_km" REAL,
  "school_sites_within_5km" INTEGER,
  "nearest_health_km" REAL,
  "health_sites_within_5km" INTEGER,
  "nearest_market_km" REAL,
  "market_sites_within_5km" INTEGER,
  "nearest_industry_km" REAL,
  "industry_sites_within_10km" INTEGER,
  "nearest_mineral_km" REAL,
  "mineral_sites_within_25km" INTEGER,
  "nearest_agriculture_km" REAL,
  "agriculture_sites_within_10km" INTEGER,
  "nearest_energy_km" REAL,
  "energy_sites_within_25km" INTEGER,
  "nearest_logistics_km" REAL,
  "logistics_sites_within_10km" INTEGER,
  "exposure_band" TEXT
, "x_coordinate_dd" REAL, "y_coordinate_dd" REAL, "coordinate_basis" TEXT)

CREATE TABLE "structure_inventory" (
"district" TEXT,
  "source_file" TEXT,
  "source_sheet" TEXT,
  "source_row" TEXT,
  "structure_name" TEXT,
  "structure_location" TEXT,
  "structure_type" TEXT,
  "structure_class" TEXT,
  "structure_age" TEXT,
  "last_major_works" TEXT,
  "last_major_work_year" TEXT,
  "current_condition" TEXT,
  "remarks" TEXT,
  "chainage_km" REAL,
  "source_occurrence_index" INTEGER,
  "source_occurrence_count" INTEGER,
  "link_id" TEXT,
  "linked_road_name" TEXT,
  "linked_road_length_km" REAL,
  "link_match_score" REAL,
  "linkage_quality" TEXT,
  "risk_band" TEXT,
  "recommended_intervention" TEXT,
  "programme_cost_ugx" REAL,
  "structure_id" TEXT,
  "allocated_road_length_km" REAL,
  "map_location_method" TEXT
, "x_coordinate_dd" REAL, "y_coordinate_dd" REAL, "coordinate_basis" TEXT)

CREATE TABLE admin_unit_distance_matrix (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            district TEXT NOT NULL,
            subcounty TEXT NOT NULL,
            total_links INTEGER,
            total_km REAL,
            bituminous_km REAL,
            gravel_km REAL,
            earth_km REAL,
            good_km REAL,
            fair_km REAL,
            poor_km REAL
        )

CREATE TABLE "global_country_matrix" ("region" TEXT,"country" TEXT,"pavement_management_system_score" TEXT,"budget_prioritization_score" TEXT,"traffic_data_collection_score" TEXT,"institutional_governance_score" TEXT,"transferability_score" TEXT,"road_network_km" TEXT,"paved_share_pct" TEXT,"condition_good_pct" TEXT,"traffic_coverage_pct" TEXT,"source_status" TEXT, "x_coordinate_dd" REAL, "y_coordinate_dd" REAL, "coordinate_basis" TEXT)

CREATE TABLE "structure_link_summary" (
"link_id" TEXT,
  "road_name" TEXT,
  "district" TEXT,
  "geometry_length_km" REAL,
  "structure_records" INTEGER,
  "bridge_records" INTEGER,
  "major_culvert_records" INTEGER,
  "dominant_structure_condition" TEXT,
  "highest_structure_risk" TEXT
, "x_coordinate_dd" REAL, "y_coordinate_dd" REAL, "coordinate_basis" TEXT)

CREATE TABLE admin_districts (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    region TEXT NOT NULL
)
